scope: Bounded exploratory M3 diagnostic follow-up; not a new untouched-test result
selection_metric: inner grouped cross-validation mean log loss
projection_distribution: fixed independent Rademacher signs divided by sqrt(output dimension); no fitted projection
feature_positions: 81 cell positions in the 89-token full prefix latent; eight row separator positions excluded from spatial variants
cheap_control_selection: choose family and C using inner folds within each outer training partition
calibration_policy: new exploratory discrimination uses uncalibrated raw margins; no test-driven recalibration or sign inversion
interval_limitations: paired puzzle-cluster percentile intervals conditional on fitted cross-validation models; models not refitted in bootstrap; exploratory selection and fold uncertainty not fully represented
no_fresh_data_policy: finish exploratory diagnostics, preserve negative result, and keep M4-M7 gated; do not relabel exposed puzzles or symmetry transforms as fresh
hardware_policy: existing local GPU for prefix reconstruction only; one CPU thread for fitting; no paid compute or new checkpoint downloads
manual_review: agent case walkthrough with raw input/output and independent constraint witnesses; not a human annotation study
stopping_rule: evaluate exactly these two spatial variants at the two declared levels once; no extra seeds, levels, models, or hyperparameters selected from results
